:::{#def-domain-of-discourse}
#### Domain of discourse, universe of discourse

The **domain of discourse**
(or **universe of discourse**)
of a [predicate](#def-predicate) $P(x)$
is the [set](#def-set) of values its variable $x$ may take. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
A predicate in several variables has a domain of discourse for each variable.

:::
